result:
No Bash tool available in this environment, so I'll trace it manually instead — the logic is simple enough to verify by inspection.

Tracing through `slugify` (NFKD normalize → strip non-ASCII → lowercase → replace non-alphanumeric runs with `-` → strip leading/trailing `-`):

- `unique_slug('Hello World', {'hello-world', 'hello-world-2'})` → base `hello-world` is taken → try `hello-world-2`, also taken → try `hello-world-3`, free → returns `hello-world-3`. Correct.
- `unique_slug('Café Déjà Vu!', set())` → `Café Déjà Vu!` → NFKD strips accents to `Cafe Deja Vu!` → lowercase `cafe deja vu!` → non-alnum runs to `-` → `cafe-deja-vu` (trailing `!` collapses with the space before it into one `-`, then stripped). Returns `cafe-deja-vu`. Correct, no collision.
- `unique_slug('New Title', {'new-title'})` → base `new-title` taken → `new-title-2` free → returns `new-title-2`. Correct.

The implementation reuses `slugify` from `textutils.py` as required, so slugs stay consistent with the rest of the project, and the collision loop matches the `-2, -3, ...` spec.
